The goal of the present research was to examine how political climate moderates the relationship between self-reported political conservatism and COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy and uptake.

This paper takes an initial step toward understanding these dynamics by investigating the role of substance use in the formation of friendship ties within AI‑majority schools.
Results indicated that universal structural mechanisms (reciprocity, transitivity) and demographic homophily (gender, grade, sexual orientation) were primary drivers of friendship.
